study type: Retrospective review of adverse events and chart audit with prospective data collection for breastfeeding metrics (case series/cluster report)
cohort: Mothers and their infants admitted to a hospital where a program to improve breastfeeding, including rooming-in, was implemented.
finding: A cluster of three in-hospital neonatal falls occurred within one year of commencing breastfeeding improvement efforts involving rooming-in, all associated with mothers falling asleep while feeding between midnight and 6 AM.
